e.title: 一个把「经纪公司平时怎么运作」整个开源的平台（西语代码库、MIT）：**每一次预测都记录模型、版本、输入特征与一句人话解释，且**从不覆盖业务记录——人的决定永远优先****；而**已上线的模型自称是「可解释的基线」并说明自己是给学习模型设的下限**
e.title_en: A platform that open-sources how a brokerage actually operates — a Spanish-language codebase under MIT — where every prediction records its model, version, input features and a plain-language explanation and never overwrites a business record, since a human decision always wins, and where the shipped models call themselves interpretable baselines and serve as a floor for a learned model to beat
e.title_hk: 一個把「經紀公司平時怎麼運作」整個開源的平台（西語代碼庫、MIT）：**每一次預測都記錄模型、版本、輸入特徵與一句人話解釋，且**從不覆蓋業務記錄——人的決定永遠優先****；而**已上線的模型自稱是「可解釋的基線」並說明自己是給學習模型設的下限**
e.summary: 一份面向**保险经纪公司**的平台（西语代码库）：把「客户 → 网站 → 申请 → CRM → 顾问 → 跟进 → 成交 → 续保」这一整条链路做成**一套系统**，**并从第一次迁移起就是多租户**（**逐字「one deployment serves many brokerages」**）；**其最值得记的一处是它对「预测」的处理规则**——**逐字「**每一次预测都记录模型、它的版本、它的输入特征和一句人可读的解释，而它们**从不覆盖任何业务记录。人的决定永远优先。**」**；**而第二处是它对自己模型的定位**——**逐字「已上线的模型是**可解释的基线**，而**它们自己也这么说**。它们的职责是在没有标注数据的情况下从第一天就能用、**记录未来真实模型要训练的那些特征**，**并成为一个学习模型必须超越的下限**」**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① **智能不是一个后加的第三阶段功能**（**逐字「它从第一次迁移起就在 schema 里」，并指向一份关于「智能层」的架构决策记录**）；**② **线索评分把**理由给顾问看****（**逐字「with the reasons shown to the advisor」**）**；**③ **演示数据全为合成、由固定种子生成**（**逐字「All demo data is synthetic and generated from a fixed seed. **No real client data is in this repository.**」**）
e.summary_hk: 一份面向**保險經紀公司**的平台（西語代碼庫）：把「客戶 → 網站 → 申請 → CRM → 顧問 → 跟進 → 成交 → 續保」這一整條鏈路做成**一套系統**，**並從第一次遷移起就是多租戶**（**逐字「one deployment serves many brokerages」**）；**其最值得記的一處是它對「預測」的處理規則**——**逐字「**每一次預測都記錄模型、它的版本、它的輸入特徵和一句人可讀的解釋，而它們**從不覆蓋任何業務記錄。人的決定永遠優先。**」**；**而第二處是它對自己模型的定位**——**逐字「已上線的模型是**可解釋的基線**，而**它們自己也這麼說**。它們的職責是在沒有標註數據的情況下從第一天就能用、**記錄未來真實模型要訓練的那些特徵**，**並成為一個學習模型必須超越的下限**」**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① **智能不是一個後加的第三階段功能**（**逐字「它從第一次遷移起就在 schema 裡」，並指向一份關於「智能層」的架構決策記錄**）；**② **線索評分把**理由給顧問看****（**逐字「with the reasons shown to the advisor」**）**；**③ **演示數據全為合成、由固定種子生成**（**逐字「All demo data is synthetic and generated from a fixed seed. **No real client data is in this repository.**」**）
e.summary_en: A platform for insurance brokerages, in a Spanish-language codebase, that makes the whole chain from client through website, request, CRM, advisor, follow-up, sale and renewal into one system, multi-tenant from the first migration so that one deployment serves many brokerages; **its most notable feature is its rule for predictions** — verbatim, every prediction records the model, its version, its input features and a human-readable explanation, and none of them ever overwrites a business record, because a human decision always wins; **and its second is how it positions its own models** — verbatim, the shipped models are interpretable baselines and they say so, their job being to work from day one with no labelled data, to log the features a real model will train on, and to be a floor that a learned model has to beat; **three further points follow the same discipline**: **the intelligence is not a phase-three feature bolted onto a CRM but is in the schema from the first migration**, pointing at an architecture decision record about the intelligence layer; **lead scoring shows its reasons to the advisor**; **and all demo data is synthetic from a fixed seed, with no real client data in the repository**
e.body:
**corredor-broker-platform**（仓库 `Scarta19/corredor`，西语意为「经纪人／中介」）**是一份面向保险经纪公司的平台**：**把「客户 → 网站 → 申请 → CRM → 顾问 → 跟进 → 成交 → 续保」整条链路做成一套系统**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **MIT**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 542 KB、**创建与最后推送同为 2026-09-10**、无 topics、无 homepage 字段**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内**）；**README 实测 6,752 字节**；**仓库实测共 273 个条目（202 个文件、71 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把平时不外传的东西拿出来」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把「一家经纪公司平时怎么运作」开源得最完整的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它给出了关于「预测」的一条规则，而这条规则的形状在本会话里很熟悉**——**逐字为**：**「Every prediction records **the model, its version, its input features and a human-readable explanation**, and **none of them ever overwrite a business record**. **A human decision always wins.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **四件东西随每一个预测一起存下**（**模型／版本／输入特征／一句人可读的解释**）**——**⭐ 即**「这个分数是怎么来的」是**随分数走的字段**（**⭐ 与第 340 轮 [[insurance-portfolio-performance]] 的「出典随自治体数据同行」、第 342 轮 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的「夹具含中间值」同族**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「从不覆盖业务记录」是一条**禁止性规则****——**⭐ 即**预测**不能写回并改写客户、保单等业务数据**（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本节最实在的一句：**它把「模型只能提意见」写成了**数据层面的约束****）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「人的决定永远优先」**——**把人的优先权写成一句结论**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[prediction-lab-actuarial]] 的「审批保持为人类专属且不可逆的行为」同族**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它对自己已上线的模型给出了**定位**，而且这个定位是「我不好，我知道」**——**逐字为**：**「**The shipped models are interpretable baselines, and they say so.** Their job is to **work from day one with no labelled data**, **log the features a real model will train on**, and **be a floor that a learned model has to beat**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「可解释的基线，而它们自己也这么说」**——**⭐ 即**它**不把基线当成品**，**而是**把基线的身份写在文档里****（**⭐ 本词条认为这与第 342 轮 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的「a pricing-based prior would be the natural fix, **and I have not built or measured one**」是同一纪律的另一种表述**）；**② ⭐⭐ **「从第一天就能用、且记录未来真实模型要训练的特征」**——**⭐ 即**基线的两个职责被分别写明**（**今天可用／为将来铺路**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「一个学习模型必须超越的下限」**——**⭐ 即**它给未来的复杂模型设了一条**必须跨过的线**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] 的「先拟合一个简单模型、确认它是否超过机会水平」可并读**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「AI 原生」定义成**schema 层面的事**，而不是一个功能**——**逐字为**：**「The intelligence isn’t a phase-three feature bolted onto a CRM — **it’s in the schema from the first migration**（**ADR-0005**）」**；**并逐条说明它的四个用途**：**线索评分**（**逐字「which of this month’s requests to call first, **with the reasons shown to the advisor**」**）、**续保风险**（**逐字「days-to-expiry is a calendar; churn probability is a work queue」**）、**交叉销售**、**消息理解**（**逐字「people write "necesito asegurar mi carro", not "1"」**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「不是一个加在 CRM 上的第三阶段功能」**——**⭐ 即**它区分了**「把 AI 接进来」与「把 AI 设计进去」****；**② ⭐⭐ **「续保风险」那一句把日历换成了工作队列**（**⭐ 即**它改变的是**顾问看什么**，而不只是**多一个分数**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **评分**把理由给顾问看****（**⭐ 即**可解释性被当作**给使用者的功能**而不是合规装饰**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **六个模块并列且状态都是 Done**（**专业网站／智能报价器／WhatsApp 渠道／CRM／续保／看板**）**，**且 WhatsApp 一项有一个脚注**——**逐字「Built and tested end to end; **sending needs the brokerage’s own Meta Business credentials**」**（**⭐ 即**它说清了**为什么这一项在别人的部署里不能直接用****）；**② **多租户从第一次迁移起**（**逐字「one deployment serves many brokerages, each with its own catalogue, forms, pipeline and book of business」**）；**③ **架构是模块化单体**并指向另一份决策记录**（**逐字 ADR-0001**）；**④ **技术栈逐项列出**（**Python 3.13／FastAPI／SQLAlchemy 2 async／Alembic／Pydantic v2；PostgreSQL 17／Redis；Next.js App Router／TypeScript／Tailwind；scikit-learn／Anthropic SDK；uv／ruff／mypy strict／pytest／GitHub Actions**）；**⑤ **本地启动逐条给出**（**`make install`／`make up`／`make migrate`／`make seed`／`make api`／`make web`，**并逐字说明需要一个带合成业务量的演示租户**）。**⑤ ⭐ **语言维度**：**其代码库、模块名、链路图与**架构决策记录的文件名**都是**西班牙语****（**如 `docs/adr/0005-capa-de-inteligencia.md`、`docs/adr/0001-monolito-modular.md`**）**。**⑥ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[brokerflow-renewal-crm]]、[[drtakaful-agent-crm]]、[[prediction-lab-actuarial]]、[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、[[application-fill-provenance]]、[[insurance-client-attribution]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[colombian-pension-observatory]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⭐ **许可为 **MIT****——**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**；**⭐ 而**本词条**未读其内容**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未运行该平台的任何一步****——**未克隆、未安装 uv／Node／Docker、未建 Postgres 或 Redis、未运行 `make` 任何目标、未运行 `make test`、未运行 `mypy` 或 `ruff`、未打开任何界面**；**故**本词条**不主张**其六个模块可用、其多租户隔离成立、其预测记录机制确实实现**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明与其文件结构**（**202 个文件**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何源码、迁移或 `docs/` 内容****——**⭐ 即**本词条**未核对**：**「每一次预测都记录模型、版本、特征与解释」是否确实实现**（**⚠️ 这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**）；**预测是否确实无法覆盖业务记录**；**多租户隔离是否确实在查询层实现**（**⭐ 这是一条**安全相关的断言**，而本词条只有 README 作依据**）；**`ADR-0005` 与 `ADR-0001` 是否确实如描述**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其自述的模块「Done」状态与实际完成度**（**⭐ 其首页另有一句**逐字**「**in active development**… modules are being built in the order set out in the roadmap」**——**⭐ 本词条把这两处**并列写出**：**模块表说六项 Done，而状态行说仍在开发中**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这是矛盾**（**表可能指已实现范围，状态行指整体**），**只如实记录**，**并指出**读者应以后者的整体判断为准****）。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其演示数据是否确实全为合成**（**⭐ 其 README 逐字声明由固定种子生成、仓库中无真实客户数据**；**⚠️ 本次未读任何种子或数据文件**）。**⑥ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其调用外部模型（`Anthropic SDK`）时如何传输客户信息**（**⭐ 这是一个**客户数据流向第三方模型**的实质问题**；**⚠️ 本词条未读其隐私或数据处理说明**）。**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其作者身份、资历**或**该平台是否被任何经纪公司使用**——**不主张**它已投入生产**。**⑧ ⭐ **★0、fork 0**，**关注度为零**，**且**该仓库**在被检索到时创建不足两天****——**⭐ 如实记录：**这是一个**极新的仓库**，**其成熟度无从判断****。**⑨ ⚠️ **创建与推送同为 2026-09-10****（**均在解冻窗口之内**）**。**⑩ ⚠️ **README 为**西班牙语与英语混用**（**叙述为英语，而领域术语、模块名与 ADR 文件名为西班牙语**）**——**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其已有三语版本**。**⑪ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Scarta19/corredor` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可 MIT、★数、fork 数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间、topics 与 homepage）；README 6,752 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**本词条据其引用其问题陈述、链路图、六模块表、AI 原生一节、预测规则、基线定位、架构与技术栈**）；**仓库全部 273 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对（**202 文件、71 目录**）；**未克隆、未安装任何依赖、未运行任何命令或测试、未读任何源码／迁移／文档内容、未打开任何界面、未做任何网络观察、未打开任何图**。
e.body_hk:
**corredor-broker-platform**（倉庫 `Scarta19/corredor`，西語意為「經紀人／中介」）**是一份面向保險經紀公司的平台**：**把「客戶 → 網站 → 申請 → CRM → 顧問 → 跟進 → 成交 → 續保」整條鏈路做成一套系統**。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **MIT**（**實測倉庫內含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主語言 Python、體量 542 KB、**創建與最後推送同為 2026-09-10**、無 topics、無 homepage 字段**（**創建與推送均在解凍窗口之內**）；**README 實測 6,752 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 273 個條目（202 個文件、71 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把平時不外傳的東西拿出來」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**把「一家經紀公司平時怎麼運作」開源得最完整的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它給出了關於「預測」的一條規則**：**「Every prediction records **the model, its version, its input features and a human-readable explanation**, and **none of them ever overwrite a business record**. **A human decision always wins.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 四件東西隨每一個預測一起存下**（模型／版本／輸入特徵／一句人可讀的解釋，即「這個分數是怎麼來的」是隨分數走的字段；與第 340 輪 insurance-portfolio-performance 的「出典隨數據同行」、第 342 輪 ratecraft 的「夾具含中間值」同族）；**② ⭐⭐⭐「從不覆蓋業務記錄」是一條**禁止性規則****（預測不能寫回並改寫客戶、保單等業務數據——**把「模型只能提意見」寫成了數據層面的約束**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐「人的決定永遠優先」**（與第 342 輪 prediction-lab 的「審批保持為人類專屬且不可逆的行為」同族）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它對自己已上線的模型給出了定位，而這個定位是「我不好，我知道」**：**「**The shipped models are interpretable baselines, and they say so.** Their job is to **work from day one with no labelled data**, **log the features a real model will train on**, and **be a floor that a learned model has to beat**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「可解釋的基線，而它們自己也這麼說」**（不把基線當成品，而是把基線的身份寫在文檔裡；與第 342 輪 ratecraft 的「a pricing-based prior would be the natural fix, and I have not built or measured one」是同一紀律的另一種表述）；**② ⭐⭐「從第一天就能用、且記錄未來真實模型要訓練的特徵」**（基線的兩個職責被分別寫明：今天可用／為將來鋪路）；**③ ⭐⭐「一個學習模型必須超越的下限」**（與第 342 輪 insurance-claims-risk-analytics 的「先擬合一個簡單模型、確認它是否超過機會水平」可並讀）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「AI 原生」定義成 schema 層面的事而不是一個功能**：**「The intelligence isn’t a phase-three feature bolted onto a CRM — **it’s in the schema from the first migration**（**ADR-0005**）」**；並逐條說明四個用途（線索評分「with the reasons shown to the advisor」／續保風險「days-to-expiry is a calendar; churn probability is a work queue」／交叉銷售／消息理解「people write "necesito asegurar mi carro", not "1"」）**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「不是一個加在 CRM 上的第三階段功能」**（區分了「把 AI 接進來」與「把 AI 設計進去」）；**② ⭐⭐「續保風險」那一句把日曆換成了工作隊列**（改變的是顧問看什麼，而不只是多一個分數）；**③ ⭐⭐ 評分把理由給顧問看**（可解釋性被當作給使用者的功能而不是合規裝飾）；**④ ⭐⭐ **其餘細節**：**① 六個模組並列且狀態都是 Done**（專業網站／智能報價器／WhatsApp 渠道／CRM／續保／看板），**且 WhatsApp 一項有一個腳註**——逐字「Built and tested end to end; **corredor-broker-platform** (repository `Scarta19/corredor`, the Spanish word for a broker or intermediary) **is a platform for insurance brokerages** that turns the whole chain from client to website, request, CRM, advisor, follow-up, sale and renewal into one system. **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **MIT** (a `LICENSE` file is measurably present), primary language Python, a 542 KB repository, created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-10, no topics and no homepage field** (all GitHub API measurements; **creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 6,752 bytes**; **the repository measures 273 entries (202 files, 71 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **bringing out what is normally kept in-house**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it open-sources how a brokerage actually operates most completely**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It states a rule about predictions** — verbatim, every prediction records **the model, its version, its input features and a human-readable explanation**, and **none of them ever overwrites a business record**, because **a human decision always wins** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **four things travel with every prediction, so how a score was produced is a field that accompanies the score**, ⭐ **the same family as round 340’s provenance travelling with each municipality’s record and round 342’s fixtures carrying their intermediates**; ⭐⭐⭐ **never overwriting a business record is a prohibitive rule, making "the model may only advise" a constraint at the data layer**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ a human decision always winning states human precedence as a conclusion**, ⭐ **the same family as round 342’s approval being a human-only and irreversible act**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It positions its own shipped models, and the positioning is that they are not good and they know it** — verbatim, **the shipped models are interpretable baselines and they say so**, their job being to **work from day one with no labelled data**, **log the features a real model will train on**, and **be a floor that a learned model has to beat** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **calling them baselines that say so writes the baseline’s identity into the documentation rather than passing it off as a product**, ⭐ **the same discipline as round 342’s note that a better prior would be the natural fix and had not been built**; ⭐⭐ **the baseline’s two duties are separated, being usable today and paving the way for tomorrow**; **and ⭐⭐ being a floor a learned model has to beat sets a line future complexity must cross**, ⭐ **readable alongside round 342’s advice to fit a simple model and check whether it clears chance level**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It defines being AI-native as a schema-level matter rather than a feature** — verbatim, the intelligence is not a phase-three feature bolted onto a CRM but **is in the schema from the first migration**, pointing at an architecture decision record about the intelligence layer; **with four uses itemised**: **lead scoring** about which of this month’s requests to call first, **with the reasons shown to the advisor**; **renewal risk**, where days-to-expiry is a calendar while churn probability is a work queue; **cross-sell**; **and message understanding**, since people write that they need to insure their car rather than pressing one ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **not being a phase-three feature separates connecting AI to something from designing AI into it**; ⭐⭐ **the renewal-risk line replaces a calendar with a work queue, changing what the advisor looks at rather than merely adding a score**; **and ⭐⭐ scoring shows its reasons to the advisor, treating explainability as a feature for the user rather than compliance decoration**. **④ ⭐⭐ Other details**: **six modules are listed with every state marked done** — professional website, intelligent quoting, a WhatsApp channel, CRM, renewals and a dashboard — **with a footnote on the WhatsApp item reading verbatim that it is built and tested end to end but that sending needs the brokerage’s own business credentials**, ⭐ **so why that item cannot be used directly in someone else’s deployment is stated**; **multi-tenancy exists from the first migration, one deployment serving many brokerages each with its own catalogue, forms, pipeline and book of business**; **the architecture is a modular monolith, pointing at another decision record**; **the stack is itemised**; **and local startup steps are given command by command, including a demo tenant seeded with a synthetic book of business**. **⑤ ⭐ On language**: **the codebase, module names, the pipeline diagram and the architecture decision record filenames are all in Spanish**. **⑥ ⭐ Readable with** [[brokerflow-renewal-crm]], [[drtakaful-agent-crm]], [[prediction-lab-actuarial]], [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]], [[application-fill-provenance]], [[insurance-client-attribution]], [[insurance-data-tools]] and [[colombian-pension-observatory]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⭐ Licence is MIT** — **a `LICENSE` file is measurably present**, ⚠️ **whose contents were not read**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No part of the platform was run** — **nothing was cloned, no dependency was installed, no database or cache was created, no make target was run, no test or type check was run, and no interface was opened**; **so its six modules are not claimed to work, its multi-tenant isolation is not claimed to hold, and its prediction-recording mechanism is not claimed to be implemented** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and its file structure**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source, migration or docs content was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether every prediction really records its model, version, features and explanation, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry; whether predictions really cannot overwrite business records; whether multi-tenant isolation is really implemented at the query layer, a security-related assertion supported here only by the README; and whether the two decision records say what is described**. **④ ⚠️ The claimed done state of the modules was not verified against actual completeness** — ⭐ **the front page also carries a line reading verbatim that the project is in active development with modules being built in roadmap order, and the entry sets the two side by side**: the module table says all six are done while the status line says development continues. ⚠️ **No contradiction is asserted, since the table may describe the implemented scope**, but the entry records both and notes that a reader should take the overall status line as governing. **⑤ ⚠️ Whether its demo data really is entirely synthetic was not verified** (**the README states verbatim that it is generated from a fixed seed with no real client data in the repository**, ⚠️ **but no seed or data file was read**). **⑥ ⚠️⚠️ How it transmits customer information when calling an external model was not verified** — **a substantive question about client data reaching a third-party model**, ⚠️ **and no privacy or data-handling statement was read**. **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity, background and any brokerage use were not verified** — **no claim is made that it runs in production**. **⑧ ⭐ At ★0 with 0 forks**, **attention is zero**, ⭐ **and the repository was under two days old when found, so no maturity can be judged**. **⑨ ⚠️ Its creation and push are the same day, 2026-09-10**, both inside the window. **⑩ ⚠️ The README mixes Spanish and English**, with narrative in English while domain terms, module names and decision record filenames are Spanish — ⚠️ **no trilingual version is claimed**. **⑪ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Scarta19/corredor` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence MIT, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates, topics and homepage); the 6,752-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, the entry quoting its problem statement, pipeline diagram, module table, AI-native section, prediction rule, baseline positioning, architecture and stack; **all 273 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**202 files, 71 directories**); **nothing was cloned, no dependency was installed, no command or test was run, no source, migration or documentation contents were read, no interface was opened, no network observation was made, and no image was opened**.

**sending needs the brokerage’s own Meta Business credentials**」（說清了為什麼這一項在別人的部署裡不能直接用）；多租戶從第一次遷移起（逐字「one deployment serves many brokerages, each with its own catalogue, forms, pipeline and book of business」）；架構是模組化單體並指向另一份決策記錄（ADR-0001）；技術棧逐項列出（Python 3.13／FastAPI／SQLAlchemy 2 async／Alembic／Pydantic v2；PostgreSQL 17／Redis；Next.js App Router／TypeScript／Tailwind；scikit-learn／Anthropic SDK；uv／ruff／mypy strict／pytest／GitHub Actions）；本地啟動逐條給出（make install／up／migrate／seed／api／web，並逐字說明需要一個帶合成業務量的演示租戶）；⭐語言維度：代碼庫、模組名、鏈路圖與架構決策記錄的文件名都是西班牙語（如 docs/adr/0005-capa-de-inteligencia.md、docs/adr/0001-monolito-modular.md）；⚠️⚠️未運行該平台的任何一步（未克隆、未安裝 uv／Node／Docker、未建 Postgres 或 Redis、未運行 make 任何目標、未運行 make test、未運行 mypy 或 ruff、未打開任何界面），故不主张其六個模組可用、其多租戶隔離成立、其預測記錄機制確實實現——本詞條核實到的是 README 的逐字聲明與其文件結構；⚠️⚠️未讀任何源碼、遷移或 docs/ 內容——即未核對「每一次預測都記錄模型、版本、特徵與解釋」是否確實實現（**這是本條最需要後續核實的一處**）、預測是否確實無法覆蓋業務記錄、多租戶隔離是否確實在查詢層實現（**這是一條安全相關的斷言，而本詞條只有 README 作依據**）、兩份 ADR 是否確實如描述；⚠️未核實其自述的模組 Done 狀態與實際完成度（**其首頁另有一句逐字「in active development… modules are being built in the order set out in the roadmap」——本詞條把這兩處並列寫出：模組表說六項 Done，而狀態行說仍在開發中；⚠️不主张這是矛盾，只如實記錄並指出讀者應以後者的整體判斷為準**）；⚠️未核實其演示數據是否確實全為合成（其 README 逐字聲明由固定種子生成、倉庫中無真實客戶數據；未讀任何種子或數據文件）；⚠️⚠️未核實其調用外部模型（Anthropic SDK）時如何傳輸客戶信息（**這是一個客戶數據流向第三方模型的實質問題**；未讀其隱私或數據處理說明）；⭐未核實其作者身份、資歷或該平台是否被任何經紀公司使用，不主张它已投入生產；★0、fork 0，關注度為零，且該倉庫在被檢索到時創建不足兩天——極新的倉庫，成熟度無從判斷；⚠️創建與推送同為 2026-09-10（均在解凍窗口之內）；⚠️README 為西班牙語與英語混用（敘述為英語，領域術語、模組名與 ADR 文件名為西班牙語），不主张其已有三語版本；⚠️本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見。核實手段補充說明：倉庫全部 273 個條目經下載 codeload.github.com tarball 後以 tar tz 列出核對；未克隆、未安裝任何依賴、未運行任何命令或測試、未讀任何源碼／遷移／文檔內容、未打開任何界面、未做任何網絡觀察、未打開任何圖
